cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Go of the Grudge
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me carry a box. Missing your birthday doesn't make me incompetent with your glassware; I'll pack it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. Let me get one thing right today. Give me something fragile; I'll support the base, not drag it by the tape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll keep them upright all the way. At the new place, let me unwrap two. Two, please; don't leave me packing them away again without you.

reason: Make A careful handling expertise the bid to loosen birthday-based exclusion, with B specific glasses causing a request for shared use.
